articleTitle: Smart Energy Meter Surveillance Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electricity plays a cardinal role in day to day life. The electrical energy consumption in India is the third biggest after China and USA with 5.5% global share in 2016. The per person energy use rate in India is closer to 0.7 KW. India's share with global energy demand will rise to 9% by 2035. Internet of Things (IoT) is an emerging field and IoT based devices have created a revolution in electronics and IT. The foremost objective of this project is to create awareness about energy consumption and efficient use of home appliances for energy savings. Due to manual work, our existing electricity billing system has major drawbacks. This system gives the information on meter reading, power cut and the alert systems for producing an alarm when energy consumption exceeds beyond the specified limit using IoT. This idea is being implemented to reduce the human dependency to collect the monthly reading and minimize the technical problems regarding billing process. This project extends the design and implementation of an energy monitoring system with the pre-intimation of power agenda using Arduino micro controller and a GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) module. The advantage of this system is that a user can understand the power consumed by the electrical appliances on the daily basis and can take further steps to control them and thus help in energy conservation. From the electricity board section, the information regarding the bill amount, payment and the pre-planned power shut down details are communicated to the consumer. If the customer does not pay the bill in time, the user is informed through a message. If still the customer does not pay the bill, then as per designated consideration, one alert message will be sent then automatically power connection is disconnected from the remote server. In the already existing smart energy meter, it shows the energy consumed by the appliances from the date of installation of the energy meter and its corresponding rupees. In this proposed energy meter, the meter gives the energy consumed on daily basis, its corresponding rupees, billing details and payment using IoT. Additionally, it has the main objective of giving the preintimation of power schedule and an alert system for producing an alarm when the energy consumption exceeds beyond the certain limit. It also has the facility of terminating the power supply when the residents are out of station to minimize the wastage of energy. This system not only reduces the power cut issues and the labor cost for noticing the residential energy consumption in regular intervals but also increases the energy conservation with the help of alarm systems and the energy meter accuracy by reducing the billing error and the cost of maintenance.

articleTitle: A Review on Speed Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drive Using Different Control Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Present day's industry machinery is widely developed accessible motion control systems in which control of electric machines plays a necessary part in the system. Therefore, the high - performance motor control systems present, to a great scope, to the preferable performance of automated manufacturing sector by increasing the production rate and the high quality of industrial outcomes.By reason of high accuracy, high torque coefficient, and low ripple torque, good speed control, compact size and less maintenance specifications the PMSmachines are even used in unstable speed operation. This paper represents the Special speed regulating methods using a PMSM Drive. The PMSM is progressively used in high - performance applications in industry. Such function depends upon good speed controllers with high certainty, high torque coefficient, and flexibility, and low ripple torque, and high ability. Many speed control strategies are present in the rapid world and these techniques differ from kind of controller used for PMS AC motor to the kind of software/hardware utilization. A view of several control techniques is highlighted in this research and speed control & implementation of a speed controller are reviewed.

articleTitle: Power Loss Minimization in a Radial Distribution System with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Integration of distributed generation (DG) in a distribution network is a key for power loss mitigation and improvement in the voltage profile. In this paper, a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) based optimization technique has been used to determine the optimal sizes and corresponding locations of DGs to be placed in a distribution network for reduction of power loss and improvement in the voltage profile. The MINLP technique considered in this paper, utilizes the sequential quadratic programming (SQP) through ‘fmincon’ function available in the MATLAB optimization toolbox. The MINLP technique has been applied for solving the problem of optimal DG placement in IEEE 33-Bus and 69-Bus distribution systems. For the purpose of load flow, a well-known direct load flow technique has been used. After the analysis of the results obtained for the two test systems, it can be concluded that MINLP is an effective approach for minimizing the distribution network losses and improving the system voltage profile by optimally placing the DGs of suitable sizes at appropriate locations.

articleTitle: Markov Models Based Short Term Forecasting of Wind Speed for Estimating Day-Ahead Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In order to meet the growing demand of energy, renewable resource utilization has increased in recent years. Wind is the source to a significant percentage of renewable resources and wind farms harvest this energy into electricity with the help of wind turbines. These turbines are very costly to set up and require high amount of maintenance. Accurate short term (from 30 minutes up to 6 hours ahead) wind energy forecasting is therefore important for optimal scheduling of the wind farms. The paper explores the usage of Markov Chains for forecasting wind speed during a short-term period (day-ahead hourly wind generation forecasts for an individual wind farm). The proposed prediction model depends on one variable factor - wind speed, for a specific wind turbine. The geographical location under study is taken at Jodhpur in Rajasthan, India. The performance evaluation of the proposed method is calculated using the different statistical error measures like RMSE, MAPE and MAE.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Distribution Generation Units in Radial Distribution Systems Using Nature Inspired Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Growth in energy demand is more than the energy production due to various reasons like industrial growth, rapid urbanization, increasing affordability of electric gadgets etc. The integration of existing grids with renewable energy sources provides economical, sustainable and efficient power distribution, and this allows the control of the greenhouse effect. The reduction in power loss and voltage profile improvement in distribution system can be done using some techniques such as feeder or network reconfiguration, VAR compensation with capacitor banks and distributed generation (DG). DG is localized small scale generation installed in the distribution network capable of injecting active power and providing limited reactive power support, reduced distribution losses, improved voltage profile in the system and hence the quality of the power is improved. The significant process to improve the power quality of the system is finding the size of the DG unit and their suitable locations in the system. In this paper, IPSO and a new gradient free, metaheuristic, population based algorithm called Bat Inspired Algorithm is described to evaluate the optimal size and location of DG units. Distributed load flow is carried out for 33-bus and 69-bus systems to obtain power losses and voltage at each bus. Optimization techniques IPSO and BAT algorithms are considered for the optimal placement and optimal sizing of distributed generators in radial distribution system by multi-objective optimization approach has been discussed. The practical application and efficiency of this method is evaluated using two various test systems (33 and 69-bus). The proposed methods are carried out using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Dynamic Control and Performance of a Sen Transformer for Stabilizing an AC Transmission System and Improved Voltage Profile
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The independent control of active power and reactive power flow are required in transmission line to transfer of adequate power in specific corridor. To enhance the controllability in power grid, the possible way is by regulating line impedance, voltage regulation, phase angle regulation, fault current limitation through a smart power flow controller. The “Sen Transformer” is constructed with time depended component, such as load tap changers and transformer that offers cost effective and highly reliable solution for independent control of power flow. In an ac transmission line, real power and reactive power flow are independently controlled through injecting a compensating voltage in series with the transmission line. Injecting compensating voltage through a Sen Transformer is volatile in magnitude and at volatile angle w. r. t. the voltage of transmission line and prevailing line current. To study the stability margins and the dynamic behavior of the system related with the various configuration of the system, the simple system is examined under small as well as large distraction. The outcome of the controller on various margins of stability is shown by modeling and adding the ST in the power system with large and small disturbance.

articleTitle: Fault Level Analysis in Modern Electrical Distribution System Considering Various Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Reliable power supply had always been the prime concern for the electricity consumers. With the introduction of inverter based generation technologies and smart electrical grids, there has been a huge rise in the integration of Distributed Generations (DGs) like Solar PV, micro wind, diesel, bio-mass, etc with the main grid. Integration of DG has helped in meeting the consumer demand more optimally and in minimizing the transmission losses. Distributed Generation not only has increased the system reliability, but it has also improved the quality of the power supply of the Prosumer. At the same time DG integration also brought in some new challenges- protection being one of them. Designing a good protection system and coordinating the relays would require the understanding of fault current values and bus fault levels. Fault Analysis need to be carried out in the presence of DG's, which will be used for the system protection update or to design new distribution system. Further, the addition of Distributed Generations will vary the existing fault levels (i.e., either increase or decrease). The fault currents will be different for the conventional synchronous machine based distribution sources like Diesel generators, micro hydro, combined heat and power units and for that of inverter connected based sources like Solar and Wind. In this paper, detailed analysis of the fault levels considering different types of DGs will be carried out. Towards this, four different cases are analysed - Case1: Fault level at a bus only with Grid connection, Case2: Fault level at a bus with Conventional DG sources connected, Case3: Fault level at a bus considering inverter based DG connection and Case4: considering a hybrid combination of different types of generations. `MiPower' power system simulation tool has been used for carrying out these studies. Further, results are presented and conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multiple DG and Capacitor Installation Using Dragonfly Algorithm for Loss Reduction and Loadability Improvement in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Insufficient reactive power generation has major impact on power loss, voltage stability margin (VSM) and maximum loadability of electric distribution system. In this paper optimal separate as well as simultaneous multiple installation of DG and capacitor are presented to solve these issues, which alters system reactive power flow, thereby having positive influence on system parameters. Minimization of total reactive power loss (QL) is taken as the main objective and the optimization problem is solved using a swarm intelligence based optimization algorithm called dragonfly algorithm (DA). The proposed methodology is studied using standard 33-bus distribution systems. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of DG and capacitor in minimizing Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</sub>, thereby enhancing VSM and loadability of distribution system. The efficiency of the proposed technique is also demonstrated by comparing the results with other optimization techniques.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Coherent Detritus Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Technology has reached and has modified and manipulated almost every part of us human beings. But technology seems to lag behind in developing and enhancing the waste disposal system. The waste disposal system is very ancient and outdated. As a result, the nation lags behind in waste recycling and management system, while countries like Denmark have achieved perfection to an extent such that it has begun importing waste from other countries to keep their recycle plants running. Hence this paper is aimed at modifying one significant part of waste management that can prove to improve the efficiency of waste management. Usually, the Waste Trucks will scavenge streets after garbage bins and will collect the waste. But this happens at irregular time periods. Sometimes a road is visited after the Bin overflows with garbage and a complaint is raised to the corporation. This has a lot of disadvantages as wastes are not properly managed, the bins overflow with scraps and litter the surroundings; traffic ensures as the truck blocks the road at random times. To combat this issue, we propose an idea where we enhance the waste bins by featuring it with a level indicating sensor integrated to the internet using Wi-Fi Module. The whole setup is connected to a central microcontroller. Likewise, all the Bins in an area are given the similar configuration, and these are interconnected wirelessly. Each area is distinguished and is given a separate new identification in the `Coordination Controller.' This is a web portal designed precisely where all the data of the bins are accumulated online in this portal. So by a pre-fed algorithm, the Coordination Controller will be able to determine which area needs immediate attention. The trucks will be fitted with a GPS sensor, and an App-enabled PDA will be handed to the driver. So when an area needs immediate attention, the nearby truck is notified immediately. The algorithm prioritizes areas on a basis like Schools; Hospitals are given high priority, while the less critical areais given least priority. It will be able to analyze which area requires regular attention based on the history and will provide it with a high priority. So if a particular area has a maximum waste generation, based on a pattern that area will be offered primary priority. So when the level of a bin reaches a maximum, it'll be immediately reported through the Coordination Controller to the nearby truck and that particular containeris emptied. This method is Simple, Cheap and easy to implement. This will benefit over the older process in many ways. The wastes are managed efficiently, regular collection ensures. Littering and overflow of waste is prevented. Schools and Hospital areas can be kept clean. An Arduino UNO Microcontroller, Wi-Fi Module and the level sensor will be able to change the way Waste is managed.

articleTitle: Accurate Fault Location Estimation of High Voltage Transmission Line Using Disturbance Record
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper provides a fault location technique for overhead transmission line when disturbance fault recorded data is accessible from both terminal. Numerical relay estimates the fault location based on one end data without compensating the effect of fault resistance; also it does not consider the contribution of remote source, which introduces error in fault location estimation for ground fault. Inaccurate result increases fault finding time, operating cost, revenue loss and affect the Reliability and Availability Index of Transmission system. This error can be reduced using two end data. This paper presents a technique developed to determine the fault location using pure fault voltages, currents obtained from disturbance recorder with two terminal unsynchronized data. Different fault cases are considered from the event recorder of a private transmission network and presented. The fault location is estimated based on positive sequence network using the three-phase current and voltage phasors. Results are compared with the actual fault distance spotted during post fault patrolling. The accuracy of fault location using one end and two terminal data are also compared. Two terminal algorithm is more accurate compared to one terminal algorithm because it is not affected by fault resistance and reactance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of MPPT Techniques for Negative Output Super-Lift Luo Converter and Hardware Implementation of NOSLC
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The acute energy crisis and boundless availability of the renewable energy resources compared to the finite resources of fossil fuels have made the Photovoltaic power generation, the most rapidly emergent sources of electricity. However low conversion efficiency being the major hindrances to the PV power generationis overcome withNegative Output Super-Lift Luo converter (NOSLC) connected to the panel, whose duty ratio is controlled using various MPPT algorithms to trap maximum possible power available at the panel. This work thus represents a comparative analysis of Perturb and Observe(P&O) and Incremental conductance MPPT algorithms applied to NOSLC and the hardware implementation of the NOSLC.

Author Keywords: Incremental Conductance Negative Output Super-Lift Luo converter (NOSLC)

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Hybrid Electric Vehicles Using ANN Based Support Vector Data Description
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Machine Learning classifiers suffer from the socalled curse of dimensionality. The availability of data from abnormal class is practically difficult. One-class classifiers classify data based on training samples from a huge database of normal instances. There is a loss of accuracy due to the absence of training data from the abnormal class. A possible solution is to use the class results of a one-class classifier to train a two-class ANN based classifier. The results of such a classifier can be better validated using the confusion matrix. Support Vector Data Description is a one class Support Vector Machine specifically designed to classify data regardless of linearity or separability of the data set. Several enhancements were proposed to the conventional SVDD to improve its accuracy and training speed. This enhanced classifier was used to classify instances and the class results were in turn used to train an ANN. Classification accuracy was maintained while the speed was greatly enhanced. A classifier ensemble was created using six kernels and an ANN-based voting mechanism was implemented for the dataset.

articleTitle: Studies on Epoxy Based TiO2Nano-filler for High Voltage Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent years, dry transformers are playing a dominant role in electrical system. Dry type transformers mainly comprise of different types of solid insulating materials. Traditionally, epoxy based solid insulating materials are used for the purpose of insulation. In this paper, dielectric properties of epoxy resin based Titanium di-oxide (TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) nanocomposite is presented for the use of an alternative insulation for high voltage applications. Plain epoxy resin has been mixed with different volume fractions of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sub>nano particle to study the properties of AC breakdown voltage (BDV). The AC breakdown voltage test was performed in oil medium at room pressure and temperature as on the lines of ASTM standard. It is observed that addition of nano particle to plain epoxy enhances the breakdown voltage with increase in volume fractions of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>nanofiller. BDV of 0.03% volume fraction sample shows the maximum enhancement of breakdown voltage. Therefore, nano-filler based solid dielectric will be an alternative to conventionally used solid dielectrics for compact design of HV power apparatus.

articleTitle: Investigation of Controllers for DC-DC Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The DC-DC boost converter has the most desirable features such as high efficiency, high power density, high reliability and low EMI. In this paper a comprehensive review of the control schemes used in the power electronic converters was presented. The linearization of control output transfer function of Boost converter and the various performances of controllers include rise time, peak time, overshoot and settling time are investigated. The controllers of PI, PID, PR, and PIR controllers are designed by the step response of Ziegler - Nichols tuning rule and investigation of parameters K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> as to contrivance the boost converter. Comparison of response of controllers is provided.

articleTitle: Cost Effective SCADA for Remote Monitoring and Control for Effective Process Automation Using HMI
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The process automation is made effective and more accurate with help of automation tools like DCS/PLC and SCADA. In present the industries are moving towards INDUSTRY4.0. This in simple terms can be translated as remote control and analysis of process data. In order to provide basic control action to those working on the field a HMI is fixed to the control panel with a necessary set of switches. Thus remote sharing of data to the respective field personnel can be made much easier and simple. Since, it acts as interface medium for viewing real time process in mobile over a certain area using TP-LINK connection. And same HMI screen developed can also be used as SCADA. Thus acting as cost efficient Human Interface for small and medium scale industry who is looking for cost effective automation tool and process should have less complexity for easy implementation.

articleTitle: Multiple Installation of DG and DSTATCOM in Radial Distribution Network Using Lightning Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this developed modern dynamic world the atmospheric pollution focus is now changing the power generation from conventional method into Non-conventional method. Distributed generations have been consecutively assimilated with distribution systems. Optimal size and site of Distributed generation (DG) and Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM) have significant impacts on the system real power loss and also in addition improvement of voltage magnitude in distribution system. In this study, lightning search algorithm (LSA) is used to find out the optimum placement of DG and DSTATCOM in distribution system. Reduction of real power losses in the distribution system is taken as the main objective function. The proposed technique is examined by using IEEE-33 bus standard test system. The overall optimized results show the performance of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Single and Three Phase Induction Motor Using Full Bridge Cycloconverter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project proposes a full bridge cyclo-converter for three and single-phase induction motor speed control. The speed control of Induction Motor is simple and can be made efficient by using various methods to control the action of Cyclo-converter which will control the motor performance. There are two ways to control the speed of the motor, one method is by changing the frequency and the second method is by changing the number of poles. The speed control by the second method is uneconomical because under running conditions the number of poles can't be varied and the machine size becomes bulkier, but the problems can be overcome by the first method. In this scheme, the motor supply frequency can be varied in running conditions, so it will not change the motor size. In this scheme, the Cyclo-converter is a frequency changing device. It is a power electronic device used to convert constant frequency constant voltage AC power to adjustable frequency adjustable voltage. AC power is used without a DC link. Among all the schemes the frequency method is reliable, simple and economical. By using Cyclo converter the various speed of induction motor is obtained. The merits of proposed bridge type cyclo converter for speed control of single and three phase induction motor is verified by simulations in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Single Switch DC-DC Converters for Voltage Lift in RES Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In current epoch of increased RES applications in power engineering, there is a wide-spread research on DC-DC converter topologies to strap renewable energy source (RES) to load. In the context of boosting the voltage output of RES using DC-DC converter, many DC-DC converter topologies are discussed in the literature. This paper intends to present a comprehensive review of three coupled inductor based non-isolated type DC-DC converter topologies operated with single power switch for voltage lift in RES applications. Voltage gain formulations are presented for reviewed topologies of non-isolated DC-DC converters operating with single power switch for voltage lift in RES applications. Simulation results are presented showing voltage across switch, current through inductor, voltage across diode. DC-DC converter topologies are developed and the results are obtained using MATLAB/SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: PSO Based Design of Current CCII-PID Controller for the Speed Control of BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A conventional DC motor has remained the area of interest for a wide range of applications. With the invention of BLDC motor which has many advantages over conventional DC motor, it has found it application in almost all the application by replacing conventional DC motor. Here, in this paper, we analyze the performance of BLDC motor using PID controller. To design the PID controller we have used Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) based algorithm. The seminal work of this paper is to realize the controller circuit using only one second generation Current Conveyer (CCII) circuit. The performance has been validated using simulation with handy CCII IC AD844 in Multisim. Since, the transient behavior of a motor is of main concern, so this will be worthy to mention that the paper gives results in time domain. Moreover, the paper is not restricted up to only transient response, however, it also gives various steady state parameter like error in the output when transient dies out which is usually considered after 5τ sec in the literature.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Zeta Converter Using Classical PID and Fractional Order PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to implement the Fractional Order Proportional Integral Derivative (FOPID) controller for output voltage control of DC - DC Zeta converter. Implementing a distinct control technique for DC-DC converters has also been introduced with the commercial availability of integrated circuits (ICs) to carry out this task. The simulation of Classical Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) and Fractional Order PID (FOPID) control techniques for the control of Zeta converter and its characteristics of a dc-dc converter, where aspects such as the output voltage, required peak overshoot and rise time specifications are investigated using MATLAB/ Simulink model. Through simulation it is confirmed that the propounded FOPID controller gives better the transient response of the feedback system by using a significantly smaller control effort (i.e., less on-off switches), the Internal Absolute Error (IAE) of the variations of the output voltage is minimized and improves the strength of the DC - DC ZETA converter to variations in the input voltage. Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm offers fine tuning the factors of the FOPID controller.

articleTitle: Transportation Navigation Planning of an Aerial Vehicle in a Wind Turbulent Atmosphere Using Spline Interpolation Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper proposes the transportation navigation planning of an aerial vehicle using spline interpolation technique in a stormy wind turbulent atmosphere. When operating an unmanned or manned aerial vehicle in real time scenario, it is necessary to deal with the effects of wind that causes the aerial vehicle to drift away in certain condition. In such conditions, it is hard for transporting the aerial vehicle to follow certain trajectories. In order to solve this issue, choosing an optimal shortest transportation trajectory with minimal time of travel is needed. In this research work, the prime objective is to find the most optimal aerial vehicle trajectory for transportation through a randomly generated vector field of wind values in the least possible time. Initially, waypoints are positioned in straight line from source point to destination point and after they are re-positioned to generate optimal trajectory using Probabilistic RoadMaps (PRMs) method. It is also seen that the generated waypoints not only avoids the headwinds area, but also utilizes tailwinds area for navigating and smooth operation of aerial vehicle. The trajectory that is traced is then smoothed using spline interpolation technique for smooth navigation of the aerial vehicle to reach the destined location.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Automatic Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent days, people working in agricultural fields are facing lot of problems in cultivating their crops. The solution for such a problem is provided by the solar powered irrigation system. Here with the help of solar panel, submersible pumps, PV cells are used in producing energy. In this system, the moisture sensor and the pH level sensor are powered wirelessly. The sensed data values are transferred to the user mobile via GSM communication method. The aim of this paper is to help the farmers to use water effectively and use solar energy for irrigation purpose.

articleTitle: Electrifying Villages Using Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: According to a recent survey by the Rural Electrification Corporation Limited, there are a total of 18,000 villages in India that have no access to electricity. These villages cannot be easily connected to the main grid as they are much far away from the centralized grids. This requires transmitting power through very large distances. The concepts of microgrids have been prevailing for a while in the energy industry. A microgrid is a localized group of energy resources that has the ability to support a set of defined loads and are connected with the centralized grid. But, the microgrids can also be operated with or without the support of the main centralized grid. In this work, the concept of microgrids was studied to electrify these villages which can work independently just like the main grid but by using distributed and cleaner energy resources such as the solar energy. It was found that the cost of constructing a microgrid was roughly three times cheaper than bringing power from the centralized main grid. Even though some of the villages are continually being electrified by the Indian Government, there are still many villages left that are impossible to be powered by connecting with the grid.

articleTitle: Artificial Re-Fueling System Using PLC
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The conventional re-fueling stations consume a lot of man power and low degree of accuracy making the overall experience as an unpleasant one. The project aims to enhance the gasoline filling experience at a vendor more pleasant and accurate one. The Automated Re-fueling Station (ARS) is implementing programmable logic controllers in making this a reality. Today, automation engulfs all science fields making everything simple and easily approachable. The idea of ARS sparked due to the events like inaccuracy in filling the tank and malpractices involved in it.

articleTitle: FOPID Controlled Shunt Active Filter in IEEE Nine Bus System with Improved Dynamic Time Response
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper investigates a Fractional Order Proportional Integral Differential controlled Shunt active filter for a Wind Energy Conversion Systems (WECS) connected to IEEE Nine bus system to enhance its dynamic response. The SAF is constructed with Voltage Source Inverter and proposed FOPID controller is used to generate the switching pulses. Simulation results of PI and FOPID controller based SAF are compared and the corresponding time domain parameters are validated. It is shown that proposed FOPID active filter is increase the system performance through simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Acoustic Power Transfer Using Infrasonic Sound
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Wireless transmission of power has been in research for over a century. Our project aims at transmitting electric power over a distance of room. Various methods using microwaves, lasers, inductive coupling, capacitive coupling and acoustic medium have been used. In our project, we are majorly focusing on acoustic method of transferring power. Previous attempts of transferring power using acoustic methods have employed the usage of ultrasonic sound. In our project, we are using infrasonic sound as a medium to transfer electrical power. For this purpose, we are using suitable transducers and converters to transmit electric power from the 220V AC power supply to a load over a considerable distance. This technology can be used to wirelessly charge various devices more effectively.

articleTitle: Energy Saving and Smart Billing System for Household Consumers Connected to a Smart Grid in Tamil Nadu Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper discusses the idea of offering electricity to the consumers based on time differenced tariffs. This reduces the consumption of power at peak time and increases the demand responsiveness. This scheme encourages the active involvement of consumers in the consumption of power during peak hours. The Methodology of this work is to offer electricity based on load and time of power consumption. Smart metering techniques with the real time pricing scheme make the process simpler and cost effective. Smart meters are used to measure the accurate consumption of power throughout the day in real time and facilitate the real time monitoring and load sharing features in the real time pricing scheme.

articleTitle: Design and Hardware Implementation of Self Lift Negative Output Luo Converter Using MPPT for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The design and analysis of self lift N/O luo is discussed in this paper. The incremental conductance mppt extracts the maximum power from PV panel and transfers to the load. The PV panel is designed by using equivalent circuit of PV cell. The output obtained from the solar panel contains more ripples. The ripples will produce more fluctuations. By using self lift negative output luo converter the unregulated output will be conveted into regulated voltage and stepped up to the higher voltage. For obtaining simulation results Matlab software is used.

Author Keywords: Incremental conductance (IncCond) Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm
self lift negative output luo converter

articleTitle: Green Algae, Sunflower Seed and Reduced Graphene Oxide in Organic Photovoltaic Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper describes about the fabrication of layer of a solar cell with organic materials. The organic materials used in this work are green algae, sunflower seed and reduced graphene oxide. It's a well- known fact that a green algae acts as an air purifier as it does photosynthesis and also there is comparative study between a full grown big tree and green algae of same volume as that of tree, it says that green algae consumes 70% more carbon dioxide than tree. Sunflower seed has tocopherols which is responsible for photosynthesis. Sunflower seed are used in flour form. Reduced Graphene Oxide is obtained by processing carbon rod which is taken from dry cell of a torch. The method involve in this to convert carbon rod into reduced graphene oxide is Modified Hummers Method. Till date different set of materials have been used to make layers of a solar cell, from silicon to metallic to combination of organic and metal compounds or elements. So making these layers involves complex processes and some of these processes are also not eco-friendly. All these processes are done to achieve one single goal of mimicking the natural process of photon trapping at bigger scale to convert light energy into electricity. So the main objectives of this work, firstly to get more or equal open circuit voltage and short circuit current as compared to other metallic compound used in making layers for solar cell, secondly to make layers of solar cell with simples organic or eco-friendly resources commonly available and can obtained easily without any complex processing of raw materials, thirdly instead of going for different complex processes just take the natural raw material and use it in its natural form to achieve the goal. This work is carried out by checking that whether the algae can give some open circuit voltage and it has been done successfully. Then by taking a beaker or glass pot and adding firstly, reduced graphene oxide, secondly, sunflower seed flour and lastly, algae in the same vessel containing algae and reduced graphene oxide. These three materials are added in different proportions to achieve greater value of open circuit voltage and short circuit current. So value ranges from 0.6V to more than 2V of open circuit voltage and more than 3mA for that short circuit current. The electrolyte used is water and if better electrolyte is used using same material then greater values can be achieved easily.

articleTitle: An Analytical Approach for Three-Valued Multiplexer and Demultiplexers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The next level of the Digital Design after the binary logic is ternary logic. The 3-valued logic comprises of 3 states i.e. 0, 1, 2 states. The 3- Valued logic uses less number of bits to represent the number compare to 2-valued logic. Here the Ternary multiplexers & Demultiplexers are designed which plays a major role in design of Ternary Combinational Circuits. In General, the Selection line is used for selection of inputs and outputs in Multiplexer and Demultiplexer. The Ternary Multiplexer Plays an important role in selection of Switches and also contributes a major part in designing of filters. i.e. Ternary IIR Filter Design and Ternary FIR Filter Design.

articleTitle: Power Management and Advanced Metering Infrastructure Using Wireless Network in Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Advanced metering infrastructure(AMI) is an essential tool for a smart grid system to calculate.gather, store, analyse and process the data regarding the consumption of consumers. This advanced metering infrastructure enables two way communication between the consumers and utilities. The ultimate aim of this project is to provide the power supply to the consumers in the remote areas without interruption throughout the year that is uninterrupted supply. The energy is routed through a preprogramed way depending upon the consumer's requirement when the generation of the power is not sufficient. The energy theft is detected and it makes the metering process much easier than others and the process is also simulated using the software. Eventually the power management and the metering process is combined in this project. And also power management is done through two sessions when the generation of power is not sufficient. Ultimately the aim is to provide 24*7 power supply to the consumers.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Lift Luo Converter for Pumping Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to Ultra-Lift LUO converter which is suitable for pumping applications. In now a days, utilizing of the dc-dc converters are increased because of the vast applications like locomotives, mobile charging and for utilizing the power generated from Solar and wind power plants. The voltage-lift (VL) technique was successfully applied in the design of DC-DC converters. Using the Voltage-lift technique the converter can obtain high-voltage transfer gain. The super-lift technique has been given much attention since it yields high-voltage transfer gain. The Ultra-lift (UL) LUO-converter is introduced as a novel approach to the new technology, ultra-lift technique, produces higher voltage transfer gain. Analysis and calculation of the UL-LUO converter illustrates the advanced characteristics of the converter. It projects the proposed Ultra-Lift LUO converter circuit which shows better results of high voltage transfer gain. The proposed circuit is simulated and validated with the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Sensitivity Analysis on Performance of a Typical Single Axle Battery Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper outlines the sensitivity analysis of battery energy consumption for varying vehicle parameters and efficiencies of the powertrain components in a battery driven electric vehicle. The paper elucidates the calculation of energy consumption from the battery using backward calculation algorithm. The energy consumption from battery depends on a number of factors and losses at each stage has effects of varying magnitudes in the overall efficiency. The major scope of this paper is to quantify these effects based on a sensitivity analysis and to find the critical vehicle parameter and critical component in the powertrain, allowing suggestions for the improvement in performance of the battery driven electric vehicle for a lower consumption rate based on the sensitivity analysis. This aids in a significant improvement in the electric vehicle range by intelligent design of the vehicle parameters and powertrain components. The concept is analyzed for different combinations of vehicle parameters and powertrain componentefficiencies for NEDC (New European Driving Cycle) cycles. This enables additional degrees of freedom to optimize the component design for performance and cost based on application.

articleTitle: Solid State Transfomer Based Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The impact of renewable energy integration into the power system resulted in wind power as one of the emergingtechnology in the present scheme. This paper focuses on Solid State Transformer (SST) based wind system. Itaims to attain voltage transmission from intermediate to high frequency isolation, therefrom to enable reduced volume architecture as compared with the conventional transformer. A combined configuration of doubly fed induction generatorand SST operation is proposed hereto achieve the active power compensation in the wind system [4].

articleTitle: Automated Traffic Clogging Elusion in Roadways
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traffic control system in roadways forms the important criteria in day-to-day life. However the Automated traffic control system forms better platform to eradicate traffic jams and congestion in roadways. The major disadvantage of the existing system isthat the people are not following the traffic rules. So this proposed system came in existence with some restrictions to follow the traffic rules. In this model the mechanical barrier is fixed at the junction and worked using microcontroller and timer. The mechanical barrier works with the help of servomotor. During emergency situation the RFID tag in the ambulance transmit the data to the RFID reader and feeds information to the microcontroller through zigbee. This can make better congestion free environment.

articleTitle: Performance Verification of Printer in an ATM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this present world, production of reliable products is very much important because, to survive in this competitive world industries need to develop reliable products, so it is important to find the reliability of a product. ATM (Automated teller machine) is well known technology to all. Printer is one of the important modules in an ATM. The main motive of this paper is to predict reliability and evaluating life characteristics of the printer. A case study of printer module with 3½ years data from the field is considered for the performance verification and Weibull(++) software from reliasoft is taken for the statistical analysis. In this paper, based on the Life data analysis, it is observed that Log-normal distribution of failures is best fitted.

articleTitle: Design, Development and Performance Evaluation of Automated Relay Controller for Solenoid Valve Operation During Static Test of Rocket Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of an automated relay controller for pulse mode operation of solenoid valves for switching on / off the propellant flow to the combustion chamber of a thruster during static test. This paper enumerates the design of multi-channel solenoid valve controller using electro-mechanical relays operated through microcontroller. Two application software have been developed for automation purpose - one for simultaneous operation of multiple solenoid valves, as per required pulse sequence, developed in embedded C language and the other for configuration of the system, developed in MATLAB with a GUI. The performance of the designed system has been evaluated through various tests carried out in lab, field and during static tests.

articleTitle: Effect of Change in DG Position on Parameters of a Five Bus Power System During an Islanding Situation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper shows a custom made five bus power system with a grid connected Distributed Generation (DG) source. The position of the distributed generation system is changed from bus 2 to bus 5 and the effect on bus parameters due to this change in DG position has been compared during an islanding situation. The various parameters that have been taken into account are rms voltage and current, active power, reactive power and frequency at each bus. The transmission lines connecting the buses each have a length of 100 kms. The simulation results have been obtained using MATLAB - Simulink software.

articleTitle: Power Line Commnuication -A Smart Approach for Efficient Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In a rapidly changing world new technological advancements and improvements are a constant need and in the field of communication and data transmission the necessity of a new technology is a need of the hour. The Power Line Communications (PLC) is one such technology described in this paper which allows transmission of data over existing power lines. Since power lines are almost ubiquitous this technology could have a rapidly emerging market, utilizing existing electricity power lines for high speed transmission of data and voice servers. This method could possibly be seen as a new approach for home automation and for data transmission within industries internally and externally.

articleTitle: A Review on Energy Minimization Techniques in WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Lifetime maximization has been one of the most discussed topic in wireless sensor networks as any attempt to increase the life time is very significant for the continuity in the network operation. The present paper aims to review some of the research works done in lifetime maximization through energy minimization techniques. Finally, a comparison of various techniques is presented.

articleTitle: Model Adaptive Controller for Multi-Level Quasi Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Model Reference Adaptive Controller (MRAC) is implemented for the model of nine- level Cascaded H Bridge (CHB) asymmetrical Quasi Z Source Inverter (QZSI). The proposed MRAC controller forces the output current to be sinusoidal, with low current harmonics, and to be in phase with the line voltage. The advantages of using MRAC over conventional proportional-integral control are its flexibility, adaptability, and robustness; moreover, MRAC can self-tune the controller gains to assure system stability. Since the QZSI is a non linear system, it is hard to design the controller. MRAC is simple and predict the future values of output variables using a dynamic model of the process comparing conventional PI controller. In this work, the performance of MRAC is compared with conventional PI controller based on the settling time and harmonic distortion. The simulation results clearly showed that the MRAC can lead to reduction in the settling time and harmonic distortion of the obtained output for the system. In addition to this the cascaded nine level QZSI with asymmetrical input voltage in the ratio of 1:3, whose performance is analyzed to provide a boosted output voltage and due to the asymmetrical input configuration the output voltage can be obtained with more voltage levels with lesser number of component thus lead to better outputvoltage quality with the reduction in filter size.

articleTitle: Classification of Shunt Faults in Double Circuit Lines Using Thresholding Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Doublecircuit transmission lines are being used to enhance power transfer capability and achieve increased system reliability in large power systems. However, the power circuits running over large distances develop mutual couplings which make the system protection for the different shunt line faults all the more challenging. Therefore, improvements in system reliability remain hostage to the bottleneck issues like accurate fault detection and classification. An early detection and fast classification of power system fault can help the system to be isolated, repaired and reinstated at the earliest. In this paper, the detected current signals are classified for different type of shunt faults using thresholding criteria on the discrete wavelet transform coefficients. Daubechies-4 wavelet scale-l coefficients have been used for the signal decomposition and a circuit selection criterion towards the fault classification is presented on the mean of the approximate coefficients. Power system faults being linearly separable, a meticulously designed thresholding method may suffice for the fault classification task.

articleTitle: Field Testing and Analysis of Stray Current Interference on Gas Pipeline from Metro Maintenance Base
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Stray current generated from the rail transit system will cause serious corrosion to the nearby buried gas pipelines. With the development of rail transportation and gas industry, stray current corrosion of gas pipelines is becoming more serious. Existing test research mainly focus on the rail transit line station, stray current interference from the metro depot and maintenance base does not see more. In this paper, a gas pipeline near Shanghai rail transit base has been chosen as the research object, the gas pipeline potential, soil potential gradient, and rail potential have been tested, the stray current interference intensity and flow direction in the soil have been analyzed. Results show that, the tested gas pipeline is in danger of serious stray current corrosion. The average positive deviation of the pipe-to-soil potential during the subway operation is about 0.5V, while the fluctuation range of the soil potential gradient is - 10mV/m~15mV/m. The current in soil flow into the rail in metro maintenance base while the rail-to-soil potential is negative, which is consistent with the operation of rail transit.

articleTitle: Sandwiched Piezoelectric Transducer Coupled Accelerator for Dynamic Charging in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electric vehicles are the recent trend in automobile Industry.replacing the conventional fuel technology for its zero pollution. The main issue faced in an EV is battery charging, where we use static charging technique, which becomes difficult when low battery condition arises while driving. This paper deals with sustaining the battery charge during driving, with the help of Sandwiched piezoelectric transducer below the accelerator, thereby dynamic charging takes place. Accelerator, being the most used part in an electric vehicle, can be used for voltage generation by considering the continuous application of mechanical pressure on it. Whenever the accelerator is pressed, a pressure is exerted at the outer surface of the sandwiched piezoelectric transducer, thus converting the applied mechanical force to electrical voltage, which is used to charge the ultra-capacitor and discharged at a constant rate to the auxiliary or main battery. The sandwiched piezoelectric generator is used in order to have high load capacity and the power output. It has flexible end caps with an amplifier to enhance the output power and a sandwiched piezoelectric substrate to reduce the stress concentration. The normal capacitor has been replaced by ultra-capacitor for better efficiency and large charge holding capacity. This paper deals with the proposed system's structure and the power transfer via sandwiched Piezoelectric Transducer to the ultra-capacitor.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Visualization Technique for Hybrid Electric Vehicle Components
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to efficiently distinguish the abnormalities in huge datasets by employing different mechanisms like visualization techniques and algorithms. These methods classify faulty data from available test data and represent it visually. In data visualization human interpretation is required to detect abnormalities while the algorithm classifies faulty and healthy data using rule-based algorithms. The parallel coordinates plot is developed in MATLAB. Fault diagnosis in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) was done by means of pattern recognition algorithm based on the Concordia transform. The algorithm is simulated in MATLAB with original vehicle test data. The proposed fault detection algorithm holds good for analysis of variable speed and variable torque drives.

articleTitle: A Neoteric Approach Towards Anxiety Quantification by EEG Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Anxiety has become a moiety of day today life for many, an inseparable complement of every endeavor. This serves as a fountain head of several complications and health hazards. Anxiety causes various changes in the body of which those reflected by the Central Nervous System (CNS) are predominant. This paper focuses on the exhaustive analysis of the electroencephalogram (EEG) signal concerning anxiety quantification. The signals are taken from various databases of which the MIT-BIH and Physionet databases are worth mentioning, then four chosen classification algorithms namely, KNN, QDA, LDA and D Tree respectively are applied, the Principle Component Analysis is utilized as the feature classification tool and the spectral characteristics of the sub bands are studied. Lastly the FFT is applied to the raw EEG to perform its frequency domain analysis and anxiety is thus detected in PC using MATLAB as the tool.

articleTitle: Modern Electric Engine for Future Cars
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today World, majority of the population use Fuel dependent vehicles. Parallel to current scenario, the demand for Fuel is also keeps growing day by day. On such issue, we could replace the existing engine with Hybrid Engine. It could run by both Electrical and Fuel modes of operation. In Electrical mode, A supply of 36V DC is given for excitation of temporary magnet which is fixed over engine and piston. Thereby the piston works by attraction and repulsion process. The excitation in turned off when the engine is switched to Fuel mode where is works as the concept of the as Internal Combustion Engine (IC engine).

articleTitle: Direct Energy Transfer Technique Based DC-DC Converter with Distributed MPPT for PV Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The solar based charging systems depend on factors like irradiance, temperature, MPPT tracker, etc. Its performance can be improvised by selecting appropriate converter topologies and system's design specifications. While analyzing the Solar irradiance pattern, both uniform and nonuniform (partial) shading conditions need to be considered. Normally, by-pass diodes are used in anti-parallel to the module or panel to protect it from the hot spot effect. Due to partial shading conditions, multiple local Maximum Power Points (MPP's) occur in the Power-Voltage graph, because of by-pass diodes, and only one among them is the global MPP. For best operation of PV, it is to be operated at global MPP. But, at the global MPP, the partial shaded modules/panels are unable to produce the maximum power. To utilize the power produced by each panel/module efficiently, distributed MPPT is used; where each converter is connected to a module/panel and operated at their local MPP's and the output of the converters are connected in series or parallel to meet the desired voltage and current levels respectively. This paper presents the performance of a system under uniform and non-uniform irradiance conditions analyzing stress on the converter and overall system efficiency for conventional Buck-Boost and direct energy transfer based technique with distributed MPPT for PV charging applications. The simulation is carried out using MATLAB/Simulink, and results are presented.

articleTitle: Development of Prototype Spectacles for the Blind with Digital to Voice Conversion Device
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper addresses a prototype, smart spectacles, designed and developed to facilitate conversion of the words to voice. The Rehabilitative spectacles contain a small camera at the centre point. The characters when written or printed on the paper will be captured by the camera present in spectacles and converts into digital using raspberry pi 3 which is loaded with OCR (Optical Character Recognition) method. After conversion of the data, this information will be passed through a head phones from wifi module in raspberry pi 3. Making this advanced, the digital data can be transmitted at a particular bandwidth range and converting into voice and passing information last through Bluetooth and wifi connected headphones. The spectacles are also instrumented with a pair of ultrasonic transducers mounted centrally above the bridge, and with a buzzer at one of the temples. They are used to detect paper at head level. This detects the paper and converts the character present in the paper and gives output in voice. By running OCR software on such images usually ends with low OCR performance since images can have low resolution, low image quality or colourful background. In order to improve OCR performance, different image pre-processing methods are proposed. This makes more efficient in conversion of digital data into voice. The algorithm for character topology composition has been proposed. The developed system is regarded as a step-forward towards the advancements in Electronic Travel Aids, and should contribute to the betterment of the life of individuals with vision loss.

articleTitle: Survey on NEM Relays Integrated with Schmitt Trigger Based Multi Threshold CMOS SRAM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: NEMS are of submicron range which are useful to obtain high fundamental frequencies without having any impact on its mechanical response. NEM Relay is a switch made of nano meter scale using semiconductor fabrication. These have zero current leakage and low power consumption and acts like an ideal switch which can be used instead of traditional semiconductor logics. Due to zero off state leakage NEM Relays give us a scope for low power design. To increase the cell stability than that of CMOS 6T SRAM cell, it utilizes the properties of NEM relays that is infinite subthreshold slope and hysteresis. In this paper we use Schmitt trigger multi threshold CMOS instead of conventional CMOS 6T SRAM cell in order to increase the noise so that the signal to noise ratio decreases.

articleTitle: Implementation of Sepic Converters in Wind Power Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Windpower is the one of the most assure renewable energy for generating electricity due to its less cost and as we can't merely depend on nonrenewable energy sources totally. In this paper we propose variable wind power generation system using SEPIC convertors. Space Vector Modulation switching techniques is used in inverter circuits to reduce harmonics. Thus the simulation and prototype model is built-up to reveal the value of the system. The model is carry out in MATLAB/Simulink and commencing the experimental outcome we came to know that the proposed system has the sufficient performance.

articleTitle: Study of High Voltage Inductive Voltage Transformer for Transients and Ferroresonance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Inductive voltage transformer (IVT) is an instrument transformer which is used for measurement and protection in power system. Insulation plays a vital role in reliable performance of IVT. Occurrence of partial discharge (PD) due to high voltage stress on winding reduces life of insulation and adversely affects the performance of IVT. Modern power network involves many power electronic devices which create distortion in signals of various frequencies. To increase the withstand capability against the harmonics occurred due to transients, proper design of IVT is needed. Initiation of transients can lead to occurrence of ferroresonance, as IVT has nonlinear characteristics; it has chances of causing ferroresonace with capacitance present in power cables in transmission network. This results into overvoltage and over-current in the network. Mitigation of ferroresonance is important to protect the equipments from damage. This paper deals with the detail study of IVT to which oil impregnated paper (OIP) is used as insulation, its fundamentals of design, construction and survey of mathematical models for ferroresonace and transients which impact the performance of IVT.

articleTitle: Shunt Active Power Filter for Harmonic Reduction in Microgrid Exploiting Distinctive Compensation Theory: A Technical and Eminence Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Right now, the significance of power generation employing renewable energy source rapidly increases. Identically the concept of Distributed Generation (DG) accompanying a microgrid penetrates in the conventional energy scenario. Power Quality(PQ) is one of the considerable disputes when DGs are interfaced with grid through power electronics converter. In addition the usage of non-linear loads drives the researchers to consider PQ as severely. The current harmonics procreated from the non-linear load is recognized as the setback in PQ issues. As a consequence it is foremost to cut down the percentage of Total harmonic Distortion(THD). Shunt Active Power Filter(SHAPF) is weighed as effectual in balancing the harmonic current procreated by the non-linear load. Different type of techniques are employed for momentary current harmonics compensation in APF like (i)time domain approach(instantaneous p-q theory, Synchronous d-q Reference Frame approach(SRF)) (ii)Frequency domain approach (Fast Fourier Technique(FFT), Artificial Neural Network(ANN)) or by employing appropriate analog/digital electronic filters distinguishing subsequent harmonic component. Out of this, Time-domain analysis applying P-Q theory has evolved as a new manner to analyze because of its simplicity and fast and instantaneous speed response to develop the control algorithm for the SAPF. That's why, a thorough literature study on time domain analysis has been underlined.

articleTitle: Design Considerations, Optimization and Selection of Electrical System for Solar Electric High Altitude Long Endurance Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (HALE UAVs) with Proposed ‘Approximated Iterative Method’, a Multidisciplinary Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The world is turning more renewable and automated these days. Aero-Drones are used for Surveillance purpose by Military organizations all over the world. The desirable features for such drones will be autopilot and Good Endurance. The available solar energy can be used for Drones for Long Endurance and to fly at High Altitudes. These have auto pilot feature and designed to fly for a period of time continuously. These flights or drones are called as HALE UAVs (High Altitude Long endurance Unmanned Aerial Vehicles). Thus, it is important to consider its propulsion system which is purely electrical. Proper Design considerations and choice of selection is important to maintain energy balance while flying. This paper proposes an iterative model for design, calculations and selection of Electrical System for Solar Powered HALE UAVs.
